title: Permissions
subtitle: What Claude is allowed (or refused) to do in this project. Stored in `.claude/settings.json` (shared with the team) and `.claude/settings.local.json` (your private override, gitignored).
badgeMissing: file does not exist yet — saving will create it
parseErrorBody: Could not parse JSON — fix it manually first, or save here to overwrite: {{error}}

scope.projectTooltip: settings.json — shared with your team via git

sections.allowHelp: Tools and Bash commands Claude can use without asking. Patterns: `Bash(npm test *)` matches anything starting with `npm test`; bare names like `Read` allow the whole tool.
sections.denyHelp: Tools / commands Claude is never allowed to call, even if explicitly requested. Use for irreversible operations like `Bash(rm -rf *)`.
sections.askHelp: Patterns that always prompt for confirmation, even when otherwise auto-approved. Useful for `Bash(git push *)` or anything that affects shared state.
sections.defaultModeHelp: Override how unmatched tool calls are handled. `acceptEdits` auto-accepts file edits. `bypassPermissions` skips every prompt — careful.
sections.restHelp: Everything else from `settings.json` (model, env, hooks, apiKeyHelper, claudeMdExcludes, autoMemoryEnabled…). Edit as JSON. Save validates the JSON before writing.
